BoardInfo.doc: Board summary: name, description, counts and owner.

Comment.doc: A comment pinned at a canvas point, with its replies.

fields.name: author
fields.doc: The writer's member id, set by the contract.

CommentReply.doc: A reply in a comment thread.

fields.name: author
fields.doc: The writer's member id, set by the contract.

fields.name: identity
fields.doc: The device key (64 hex) of the node that moved the pointer; one pointer per device.

fields.name: account
fields.doc: The member id of the account behind that device.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Chosen by the caller; use a fresh UUID.

fields.name: layerIndex
fields.doc: Paint order; a higher value paints on top.

fields.name: createdBy
fields.doc: The creator's member id, set by the contract; any value the caller sends is ignored.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.doc: Unix milliseconds of the last change; send the current time.

fields.name: shadowColor
fields.doc: A CSS color; omitted or `null` means no drop shadow.

fields.name: label
fields.doc:
Layer name: a `/`-separated path whose last segment is the name and whose
earlier segments are groups; omitted or `null` means unnamed.

fields.name: cornerRadius
fields.doc:
Pixels; omitted, `null` or 0 means square corners. The web client draws it
clamped to min(`width`, `height`) / 2.

ElementData.doc:
What an element is, tagged by `kind`: `rect`, `circle`, `line`, `arrow`, `path`,
`text`, `image` or `svg`.

variants.name: rect
variants.doc: A rectangle filling the element's box.

variants.name: circle
variants.doc: A circle of diameter `width`, its box's top-left at `x`, `y`; set `height` equal to `width`.

variants.name: line
variants.doc: A straight line; `points` is `"x1,y1 x2,y2"` in element-local pixels.

variants.name: arrow
variants.doc: A line with an arrowhead at its second point; `points` as for `line`.

variants.name: path
variants.doc: A freehand path; `points` is SVG path data, e.g. `"M 0 0 L 40 40"`.

variants.name: text
variants.doc:
Text. `fontSize` is in pixels; `text_align` is `left`, `center` or `right`,
`vertical_align` is `top`, `middle` or `bottom`, and either may be omitted or `null`.

variants.name: image
variants.doc: A raster image: a blob on the node named by `blobId`, with its pixel size.

variants.name: svg
variants.doc: An SVG image: a blob on the node named by `blobId`, with its pixel size.

ElementPatch.doc:
One element's share of an `update_elements` call. Fields match `update_element`'s
arguments; a field that is omitted or `null` is left unchanged.

LabelUpdate.doc: One element's share of an `update_element_labels` call.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: The new label, as for `update_element_label`; omitted or `null` clears it.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Member id: the member's account id (64 hex).

fields.name: usernameUpdatedAt
fields.doc: Unix milliseconds of the last rename; the newest rename wins.

MemberRole.doc: A joined member with their effective role.

fields.name: elements
fields.doc:
The canvas. Writer-set guarded: only accounts holding a role mask
projected from `roles` (editors, admins) may write an entry, on every
node.

fields.name: members
fields.doc: One slot per account, written only by that account.

fields.name: replies
fields.doc:
Every reply, keyed `"<comment>/<created_at:020>/<reply>"` so one
comment's thread is a prefix slice in order. Guarded like `elements`.

fields.name: cursors
fields.doc:
Keyed by DEVICE: a pointer belongs to a screen. Each entry is owned by
the account that wrote it.

methods.name: add_comment
methods.doc:
Pin a comment at a canvas point. Editors only; the author is the caller. A
comment with the same id is replaced, and keeps its replies.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-9c2d-1e0f9a8b7c6d","x":120,"y":90,"content":"Bigger logo?","created_at":1727000040000}
```

params.name: id
params.doc: a fresh UUID chosen by the caller.

methods.name: add_element
methods.doc:
Add an element to the canvas. Editors only.

`data` says what the element is, tagged by `kind`. The caller chooses `id` (a fresh
UUID); an element with the same id is replaced, keeping its original `createdBy`.
An `image` or `svg` blob is announced to the board's members.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"element":{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90","data":{"kind":"rect"},"x":40,"y":60,"width":120,"height":80,"rotation":0,"fill":"#ef4444","stroke":"transparent","strokeWidth":0,"opacity":100,"layerIndex":0,"createdBy":"","createdAt":1727000000000,"updatedAt":1727000000000}}
```

params.name: element
params.doc: the element; `createdBy` is ignored and set by the contract.

methods.name: add_elements
methods.doc:
Add up to `MAX_BATCH` (200) elements in one call, as `add_element` does for
each, and emit one `ElementsAdded` unless the list is empty. Editors only.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin, or if the call holds more than
200 elements; a refused call adds nothing.

# Examples
```json
{"elements":[{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90","data":{"kind":"rect"},"x":40,"y":60,"width":120,"height":80,"rotation":0,"fill":"#ef4444","stroke":"transparent","strokeWidth":0,"opacity":100,"layerIndex":0,"createdBy":"","createdAt":1727000000000,"updatedAt":1727000000000}]}
```

methods.name: add_reply
methods.doc:
Reply to a comment. Editors only; the author is the caller. Does nothing if the
comment does not exist.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"comment_id":"9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-9c2d-1e0f9a8b7c6d","reply_id":"1b2c3d4e-5f6a-4b7c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e","content":"Agreed","created_at":1727000050000}
```

params.name: reply_id
params.doc: a fresh UUID chosen by the caller.

params.name: created_at
params.doc: unix milliseconds; replies are ordered by it.

methods.name: bring_to_front
methods.doc:
Paint an element above every other one, by setting its `layerIndex` one above
the highest. Editors only. An unknown id is not an error.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90"}
```

methods.name: can_edit
methods.doc:
Whether the caller may change the canvas and comments.

# Examples
```json
{}
```
methods.returns_doc: `true` when the caller is an admin or editor.

methods.name: clear_comments
methods.doc:
Delete every comment and reply on the board, for every member. Admin only.
Emits no event, so other members see the change on their next `get_comments`.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an admin.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: clear_elements
methods.doc:
Delete every element on the board, for every member. Admin only.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an admin.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: delete_comment
methods.doc:
Delete a comment and its replies, for every member. Editors only. An unknown id
is not an error.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-9c2d-1e0f9a8b7c6d"}
```

methods.name: delete_element
methods.doc:
Delete an element for every member. Editors only. An unknown id is not an error.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90"}
```

methods.name: delete_elements
methods.doc:
Delete up to `MAX_BATCH` (200) elements in one call, for every member, and emit
one `ElementsDeleted` unless the list is empty. Editors only. Ids that are
already gone are not an error.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin, or if the call holds more than
200 ids; a refused call deletes nothing. A delete costs more on a large board,
so a call can run out of gas well under 200 ids; retry with smaller batches.

# Examples
```json
{"ids":["5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90"]}
```

methods.name: delete_reply
methods.doc:
Delete one reply from a comment. Editors only. A reply that is already gone is
not an error.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"comment_id":"9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-9c2d-1e0f9a8b7c6d","reply_id":"1b2c3d4e-5f6a-4b7c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e"}
```

methods.name: get_board
methods.doc:
The board's name, description, element and member counts, and owner.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: get_comments
methods.doc:
Every comment with its replies.

# Examples
```json
{}
```
methods.returns_doc: Every comment, each with `replies` ordered by `createdAt`.

methods.name: get_cursors
methods.doc:
Every pointer's last reported position.

# Examples
```json
{}
```
methods.returns_doc:
One entry per device: `identity` (the device key), `account` (the member id), `x`,
`y` and `updatedAt`.

methods.name: get_element
methods.doc:
One element by id.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90"}
```
methods.returns_doc: The element, or `null` if `id` names no element.

methods.name: get_elements
methods.doc:
Every element, in paint order.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: get_elements_by_ids
methods.doc:
Several elements by id in one read, with no batch limit.

# Examples
```json
{"ids":["5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90"]}
```
methods.returns_doc: The elements that exist, in `ids` order; unknown ids are left out.

methods.name: get_members
methods.doc:
Every member who has called `join`.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: get_role
methods.doc:
A member's effective role. Anyone never granted a role, and any id that is not
an account id, is a viewer.

# Examples
```json
{"member":"<member id from get_members>"}
```

methods.name: grant_editor
methods.doc:
Let a member change the canvas and comments. Admin only.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an admin or `member` is not an account id.

# Examples
```json
{"member":"<member id from get_members>"}
```

params.name: member
params.doc: a member id from `get_members`, or any account id (64 hex); the member need not have joined yet.

methods.name: init
methods.doc:
Create a board owned by the caller. Runs once, when the context is created,
with the context's init arguments; it is not an agent tool. The creator becomes
the owner and the only admin.

# Examples
```json
{"name":"Landing page","description":""}
```

methods.name: join
methods.doc:
Add the caller to the board's member list, under their account. Open to every
member, viewers included. Call it on first opening the board; a repeat call
changes nothing, even with a different username.

# Examples
```json
{"username":"bot","avatar":null,"timestamp":1727000000000}
```

params.name: username
params.doc: display name shown to other members.

params.name: avatar
params.doc: avatar URL; may be omitted or `null`.

params.name: timestamp
params.doc: the caller's clock in unix milliseconds.

methods.name: list_roles
methods.doc:
Every member who has called `join`, with their effective role. A member granted
a role before joining is not listed until they join.

# Examples
```json
{}
```
methods.returns_doc: One row per joined member: `member`, `role` and `account`.

methods.name: my_role
methods.doc:
The caller's effective role.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: revoke_editor
methods.doc:
Take the editor role away, leaving the member a viewer. Admin only. Admins keep
their access; this only removes the editor role.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an admin or `member` is not an account id.

# Examples
```json
{"member":"<member id from get_members>"}
```

params.name: member
params.doc: a member id or account id, as for `grant_editor`.

methods.name: send_to_back
methods.doc:
Paint an element below every other one. Editors only. An unknown id is not an
error.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90"}
```

methods.name: set_layer_index
methods.doc:
Move one element to a position in the layer order and renumber every element
from 0 up, so the order survives a sync. Editors only. An `id` that names no
element is not an error and changes nothing.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90","index":0,"updated_at":1727000020000}
```

params.name: index
params.doc: the new position; 0 paints at the back, and larger values are clamped to the front.

params.name: updated_at
params.doc: the current time in unix milliseconds.

methods.name: transfer_ownership
methods.doc:
Hand the board to another account, which becomes owner and admin. Owner only.
The caller stops being an admin and cannot take the board back.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not the owner or `new_owner` is not an account id. If a
response was lost, check `owner` in `get_board` before retrying: a repeat fails.

# Examples
```json
{"new_owner":"<member id from get_members>"}
```

params.name: new_owner
params.doc: the new owner's member id: a `get_members` id, or an account id (64 hex); they need not have joined yet.

methods.name: update_board
methods.doc:
Rename or re-describe the board. Owner only. An omitted or `null` argument is
left unchanged, and an empty string shows the value the board was created with.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not the owner.

# Examples
```json
{"name":"Landing page v2","description":null}
```

methods.name: update_cursor
methods.doc:
Report where the caller's pointer is. Open to every member, viewers included. Each
device has its own pointer.

# Examples
```json
{"x":200,"y":150,"updated_at":1727000060000}
```

methods.name: update_element
methods.doc:
Change an element's geometry or style. Editors only.

An omitted or `null` argument leaves that field unchanged. An `id` that names no element is not
an error and changes nothing.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90","x":300,"y":60,"width":null,"height":null,"rotation":null,"fill":"#22c55e","stroke":null,"stroke_width":null,"opacity":null,"corner_radius":8,"updated_at":1727000010000}
```

params.name: updated_at
params.doc: the current time in unix milliseconds.

methods.name: update_element_label
methods.doc:
Set or clear an element's layer name. Editors only. An `id` that names no element
is not an error and changes nothing.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90","label":"screen/01 Sign in","updated_at":1727000030000}
```

params.name: label
params.doc: a `/`-separated path: the groups, then the layer name. A `rect` labelled `screen/<name>` is a presentation screen. Omitted or `null` clears the label.

params.name: updated_at
params.doc: the current time in unix milliseconds.

methods.name: update_element_labels
methods.doc:
Set or clear up to `MAX_BATCH` (200) labels in one call, as
`update_element_label` does for each, and emit one `ElementsUpdated` when any
element changed. Editors only. Entries naming no element are skipped.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin, or if the call holds more than
200 labels; a refused call changes nothing.

# Examples
```json
{"labels":[{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90","label":"screen/01 Sign in"}],"updated_at":1727000030000}
```

params.name: updated_at
params.doc: the current time in unix milliseconds, shared by every label.

methods.name: update_elements
methods.doc:
Apply up to `MAX_BATCH` (200) patches in one call, as `update_element` does for
each, and emit one `ElementsUpdated` when any element changed. Editors only.
Patches naming no element are skipped.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin, or if the call holds more than
200 patches; a refused call changes nothing.

# Examples
```json
{"patches":[{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90","x":40,"y":50}],"updated_at":1727000010000}
```

params.name: patches
params.doc: one patch per element; fields as for `update_element`.

params.name: updated_at
params.doc: the current time in unix milliseconds, shared by every patch.

methods.name: update_member_username
methods.doc:
Rename the caller's own member entry. Does nothing for a caller who has not
joined.

# Examples
```json
{"username":"bot-2","timestamp":1727000001000}
```

params.name: timestamp
params.doc: the caller's clock in unix milliseconds; the newest rename wins.

methods.name: update_shadow
methods.doc:
Set or clear an element's drop shadow. Editors only. All four shadow fields are
written, and an omitted or `null` one is cleared. An `id` that names no element is not an
error and changes nothing.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90","shadow_color":"#00000040","shadow_offset_x":0,"shadow_offset_y":4,"shadow_blur":12,"updated_at":1727000015000}
```

params.name: shadow_color
params.doc: a CSS color; omitted or `null` means no shadow.

params.name: updated_at
params.doc: the current time in unix milliseconds.

methods.name: update_text_style
methods.doc:
Change a `text` element's content or style. Editors only.

An omitted or `null` argument leaves that field unchanged. An `id` that names no element is not
an error; on an element that is not text only `updatedAt` changes.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"0d6f3a52-1b7e-4c9a-8e2d-5a4b3c2d1e0f","content":"Hello there","font_family":null,"font_size":32,"bold":true,"italic":null,"text_align":"center","vertical_align":null,"updated_at":1727000005000}
```

params.name: updated_at
params.doc: the current time in unix milliseconds.

events.name: BoardUpdated
events.doc: The board's name or description changed.

events.name: CommentAdded
events.doc: A comment was added or replaced; the payload is its id.

events.name: CommentDeleted
events.doc: `delete_comment` ran; the payload is the id it was given.

events.name: CommentUpdated
events.doc: A reply was added or deleted; the payload is the comment id.

events.name: CursorMoved
events.doc: A pointer moved; the payload is the device key it belongs to.

events.name: ElementAdded
events.doc: An element was added or replaced by `add_element`; the payload is its id.

events.name: ElementDeleted
events.doc: `delete_element` ran; the payload is the id it was given.

events.name: ElementUpdated
events.doc: An element changed; the payload is its id.

events.name: ElementsAdded
events.doc: `add_elements` stored elements; the payload is their ids, in call order.

events.name: ElementsDeleted
events.doc: `delete_elements` ran; the payload is every id it was given.

events.name: ElementsUpdated
events.doc: A batch changed elements; the payload is the ids that existed, in call order.

events.name: LayerReordered
events.doc: The layer order changed or the canvas was cleared; re-read `get_elements`.

events.name: MemberJoined
events.doc: A member joined; the payload is their member id.

events.name: MemberUsernameUpdated
events.doc: A member renamed themselves; the payload is their member id.

events.name: OwnerTransferred
events.doc: The board changed owner; the payload is the member id the caller passed.

events.name: RoleUpdated
events.doc: The editor role was granted or revoked; the payload is the member id the caller passed.
